jobs.occupation: Specialkok i kantonesisk Siu Mei / Chinese BBQ.     Cantonese Siu Mei / Chinese BBQ Specialist Chef
jobs.description:
Specialkok – kantonesisk Siu Mei / kinesisk BBQ

Magasasa driver flere kinesiske restauranter i København. Som en del af vores videre udvikling ønsker vi at etablere og udvikle et nyt område med fokus på traditionel kantonesisk Siu Mei.

Vi søger derfor en erfaren specialkok, som har professionel erfaring specifikt med kantonesisk Siu Mei. Stillingen er ikke en almindelig kokkestilling, men kræver specialiseret erfaring med traditionelle kantonesiske stegeteknikker.

Arbejdsopgaver

• Produktion af traditionel kantonesisk Siu Mei, herunder helstegt and, Char Siu og sprødstegt svinekød
• Ansvar for processen fra forberedelse til færdigt produkt
• Sikring af ensartet kvalitet og høj standard
• Bidrage til udvikling og standardisering af vores nye Siu Mei-produktlinje
• Overholdelse af gældende krav til fødevaresikkerhed og køkkenhygiejne

Kvalifikationer

• Minimum 3 års dokumenterbar professionel erfaring med kantonesisk Siu Mei / kinesisk BBQ
• Erfaring med selvstændig produktion af helstegt and, Char Siu og sprødstegt svinekød
• Kendskab til traditionelle kantonesiske tilberedningsmetoder og professionelt Siu Mei-udstyr
• Selvstændig, kvalitetsbevidst og ansvarlig

Vi tilbyder en mulighed for at blive en del af Magasasas næste udviklingsfase og være med til at opbygge vores nye kantonesiske Siu Mei-koncept.

Send CV og en kort beskrivelse af din relevante erfaring til mail: job@magasasa.dk

Cantonese Siu Mei / Chinese BBQ Specialist Chef

Magasasa operates several Chinese restaurants in Copenhagen. As part of our next stage of development, we are establishing a new specialised area focusing on traditional Cantonese Siu Mei.

We are looking for an experienced specialist chef with professional experience specifically in Cantonese Siu Mei. This is not a general chef position and requires specialised knowledge of traditional Cantonese roasting techniques.

Responsibilities

• Production of traditional Cantonese Siu Mei, including whole roast duck, Char Siu and crispy roast pork
• Managing the production process from preparation to finished product
• Maintaining consistent quality and high production standards
• Contributing to the development and standardisation of our new Siu Mei product line
• Maintaining professional food safety and kitchen hygiene standards

Qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of documented professional experience in Cantonese Siu Mei / Chinese BBQ
• Experience independently producing whole roast duck, Char Siu and crispy roast pork
• Knowledge of traditional Cantonese preparation techniques and professional Siu Mei equipment
• Ability to work independently with a strong focus on quality and consistency

We offer an opportunity to take part in Magasasa’s next stage of development and help establish our new Cantonese Siu Mei concept.

Please send your CV and a short description of your relevant professional experience to mail: job@magasasa.dk

jobs.occupation: Evening Operations Inspector. Join Our Night Team in Køge!
jobs.description:
Evening Operations Inspector!

Do you thrive when the rest of the city winds down? Are you sharp on cleaning standards, customer service, and team leadership – and ready to keep operations running smoothly when the sun goes down?

We are a leading Danish facility service partner headquartered in Køge, supported by a team of 100 dedicated employees. We serve businesses across Zealand, Lolland and Falster with high-quality cleaning and maintenance solutions. Our goal is to set the standard within facility services and create a healthy, sustainable work environment for all our clients. With us, you’ll join a workplace that prioritises innovation, employee care and long-term sustainability.

About the job:

In this role, you will be responsible for onboarding new customers in the afternoon and evening, performing quality inspections on-site, and ensuring that our service always meets UFPA’s high standards. You will coach and motivate our evening staff, handle last-minute operational changes such as sickness or holiday cover, and manage schedules and documentation in Office 365. You will also support our headquarters in Køge when needed.

Your Evening Mission:

• Onboarding new customers during afternoon and evening hours.

• Quality inspections at customer locations – ensuring our high standards are met.

• Coaching and motivating evening staff to deliver their very best.

• Handling last-minute changes such as sickness or holiday cover.

• Coordinating schedules and reports using Office 365.

• Supporting HQ operations in Køge when needed.

We are looking for someone who…

• An outgoing, hands-on leader who inspires and guides the evening crew.

• Experienced in the cleaning industry (a big plus).

• Organised, solution-focused, and calm under pressure.

• Fluent in English – Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

• Digitally skilled (Office 365).

• Holds a valid Category B driving licence.

• Fully flexible and happy to work primarily in the evening.

What We Offer:

• 
A dynamic full-time position in a company focused on development and a healthy work environment.

• 
Freedom with responsibility and the opportunity to further specialise in facade cleaning and window polishing.

• 
A company vehicle (commercial plates) along with all necessary equipment and workwear.

• 
A competitive salary, with the option to negotiate a pension scheme, and opportunities for personal development.

• 
Start date: as soon as possible.

Ready to apply?

Send your CV, motivated application, and – if you dare – a short video presentation to  Victoria at vlu@ufpa.dk or if questions call 61 74 66 56

Bring your energy to the night shift – and help us keep our customers shining long after sunset!

jobs.occupation: Optical Design Engineers for our High Power Beam Combining team
jobs.description:
Optical Design Engineers for our High Power Beam Combining team

Location: Farum, Denmark | Level: PhD / Postdoc / Experienced Engineer

The Mission: Build the Next Generation of SBC Systems

At Ibsen Photonics, we are developing Spectral Beam Combining (SBC) modules for high-power laser architectures. We are looking for creative, hands-on Optical Design Engineers to take full ownership of designing, building, and optimising our SBC platform.

This role bridges the gap between theoretical physics and industrial reality. You won’t just design on a screen; you will spend significant time in the lab, iterating rapidly from proof-of-concept to robust, production-ready, scalable systems.

Key responsibilities:

• Design & Assemble: Develop compact, efficient SBC modules using Ibsen’s world-class transmission gratings, while considering optical beam paths, thermal effects and mechanical constraints.

• System Optimisation: Drive performance by refining optical alignment, mechanical stability, and complex thermal management for high-power loads in a reiterative process: design – experiment – optimise.

• Characterisation: Use advanced diagnostics to maintain beam quality (low M²) during power scaling, including wavefront sensing and spectral analysis.

• Full Lifecycle Ownership: Source optical/mechanical components and manage the transition from experimental prototypes to scalable, volume-ready designs.

• Global Collaboration: Work closely with an internal team and international partners, including potential overseas visits for joint prototyping and testing.

What you bring

You are a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a “build-test-learn” environment. Ideally, you possess:

• Education: A PhD or Postdoc in Optics, Photonics, Laser Physics, or a related field.

• Expertise:

• Hands on experience with (high-power) fibre and free-space optical systems, precise alignment, and experimental troubleshooting.

• Understanding of (and ideally experience with) SBC and CBC beam combining techniques.

• Beam quality measurement and analysis.

• Mechanical design of low-tolerance devices

• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Gaussian optics, beam propagation, and high-power laser effects (thermal lensing, runaway-effects, mitigation strategies).

• Software Skills: Proficiency in optical simulation tools (e.g., Zemax) and familiarity with mechanical CAD.

• Mindset: Independent enough to drive a project and work on your own, but collaborative enough to thrive in a flat-hierarchy, cross-functional team, sharing insights and discussing projects/next steps. The role is highly experimental and hands-on, requiring independence and a strong drive to make systems work in practice, not just on paper.

• Security Clearance: You are a European citizen with no family ties to Russia or Russian allied territories, and you have a clean criminal record.

Why join Ibsen Photonics?

• High Impact: Your designs will directly shape the future of high-brightness laser systems for manufacturing, defence, telecommunications, and science.

• Freedom to Innovate: We value experimental drive—if you have a better way to align or stabilise a system, we want to see it.

• Danish Engineering Culture: Enjoy a supportive environment with fast decision-making, real ownership, and a healthy work-life balance.

Application

If you believe you are the right candidate for the position, please submit your CV and cover letter by clicking the button below. We are looking to recruit as soon as possible but will keep the positions open until we have found the right candidates. If you want more information about the positions, please call Henrik Skov Andersen on +45 4434 7023 or email [henrik.s.andersen @ibsen.com](

Are you passionate about cutting-edge photonics, continuous improvement and innovation? Do you want to develop the processes that will enable new types of diffraction gratings – and make a real difference in industries ranging from green energy to healthcare?

We’re looking for a talented optical or nanotech engineer to join our Grating team, where we design and manufacture world-class transmission grating utilizing the advanced processes of the semiconductor industry.

Why Join Ibsen Photonics?

At Ibsen Photonics, we combine state-of-the-art technology with a strong sense of purpose. Our products help advance green energy, improve healthcare diagnostics, and enable innovation across a wide range of industries.

Since 2014, we have 5-doubled our revenue, reaching annual sales of more than 150 MDKK. We are 85 dedicated colleagues working from our R&D and manufacturing facility in Farum, just outside Copenhagen.

Join to:

• Grow with us: We offer a dynamic, innovation-driven culture with flat hierarchies, agile decision-making, and opportunities to lead innovative projects.

• Balance your work-life: We have flexible conditions and a supportive, multicultural team that values both technical excellence and personal well-being.

• Make a tangible impact: Your work will directly influence products used in sustainable energy, life sciences, and advanced manufacturing.

• Be part of something bigger: Join a company committed to sustainability (aligned with UN SDGs) and cutting-edge technology.

Your role: Product & process developer

You will join our 35-person Grating team. Our core technology and expertise revolve around understanding materials, processes, and equipment at the highest level.

Your role involves

• Innovating established Processes in order to increase our capabilities while improving robustness.

• Automating procedures and processes

• Identifying best practice and defining Standard Work in all our processes.

• Product development for global applications.

• Specifying, searching and implementing of new advanced equipment.

• Modelling and statistical analysis using tools such as Python, T-SQL, JMP, VBA and LabVIEW

Depending on your particular skills the role could include responsibility for one of our semiconductor production equipments or processes (e.g. SEM, ICP, AFM, wafer dicing, bonding, DUV Lithography)

What you bring

We are looking for someone who is both technically strong and a great team player. That is:

• Hands-on experience in nanofabrication, free-space optics or automating workflows or processes.

• A deep curiosity and problem-solving mindset regarding process development and optimization.

• A proactive and determined attitude – you take initiative and drive projects forward.

• A structured and analytical approach to troubleshooting and quality assurance.

• A collaborative mindset – you thrive in a diverse, international environment and value teamwork.

• Strong communication skills – fluency in English is required, as well as willingness to learn Danish.

Ideally you also have

• An understanding of volume production.

• Experience with statistical modelling.

• Some project management experience.

What we offer

• A workplace where your ideas matter – and where you will see them come to life

• A culture where everyone contributes to a shared goal – and takes pride in the result

• A friendly, respectful work environment with regular social events

• Flexible working hours

• Competitive salary and benefits (details can be discussed during the interview)

Ready to make a difference?

If you believe you are the right candidate for the position, please click ‘Apply for this position’ below to send your CV and cover letter. We are looking to recruit as soon as possible but will keep the positions open until we have found the right candidates. If you want more information about the positions, please call Lars Bo Madsen on +45 6079 0130 or email lbm@ibsen.com.

We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

About Ibsen Photonics

Ibsen’s core technology is optical transmission gratings and grating based spectrometers, which we design, manufacture and supply to customers worldwide. Our spectrometers find their way into medical devices and scientific instruments used in sustainable energy, industrial, pharmaceutical, life sciences, security, and many other applications.

We work closely with our customers to create value adding solutions, sharing our extensive technical knowledge in an open and honest work environment with a flat “Scandinavian” hierarchical structure.

You will join a rapidly growing company employing 85 people at our facility just north of Copenhagen, and realising a turnover of more than 150 MDKK in 2023. We work actively with the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and strive to make our business fully sustainable.

Ibsen Photonics is majority owned N. Foss & Co. A/S, a world leader in analytical solutions for the agricultural industry, with an annual turnover of 2.5 Billion DKK and more than 1.800 employees.

jobs.occupation: Specialistläkare/överläkare inom kardiologi till Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i Slagelse, Danmark
jobs.description:
Om du är på jakt för nya utmaningar på jobbet och funderar på att jobba i Danmark är kardiologen på Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i Slagelse ett självklart val.

Här kan du vara med och påverka framtidens hjärtmedicin och samtidigt få möjlighet att utveckla och leda ditt eget specialområde.

På hjärtmedicinska avdelningen (Medicin 2) kommer du som specialistläkare att spela en central roll för den kliniska verksamheten och yrkesområdets utveckling. Du kommer att arbeta i nära samarbete med avdelningens övriga specialistläkare, chefer och andra professioner för att skapa smidiga och sammanhängande patientförlopp.

Yrkesmässiga utmaningar och ett flexibelt arbetsliv

Som specialistläkare hos oss får du inte bara en tjänst. Du får möjlighet att styra inriktningen inom ett eller flera specialområden, om du har ambitionen och intresset för det.

Du får

• möjlighet att ta ansvar för och utveckla ett helt eget specialområde inom exempelvis ischemi, arytmi, hjärtklaffssjukdomar eller bilddiagnostik i form av ekokardiografi, hjärt-CT och hjärt-MR

• möjlighet att delta i forskningen vid avdelningen

• möjlighet att ingå i en högspecialiserad miljö med engagerade kollegor

• ett nära samarbete med övriga professioner och en hög grad av kollegialt utbyte.

Dessutom kan vi anpassa tjänsten så att den passar dina behov. På Medicin 2 lägger vi stor vikt vid att skapa balans mellan arbete och fritid, och vi prioriterar stort inflytande och ansvar.

Om dig

Vi tror att du

• är specialistläkare i kardiologi, eller är på väg att bli det

• fokuserar på att utveckla vårdkvaliteten och förbättra patientförloppet

• trivs i en miljö där man både för ett nära samarbete och arbetar självständigt

• bidrar till en aktiv och god arbetsmiljö

• har ett intresse för kvalitet, utbildning och eventuellt forskning

• kommunicerar öppet och konstruktivt.

Om oss

Vår avdelning bedriver verksamhet i två olika lokaler i Næstved respektive Slagelse, som ligger 30 km från varandra.

I Slagelse består avdelningen av två vårdavdelningar med 24 respektive 20 sängplatser. Därutöver har vi en hjärtmottagning samt det vårdmässiga ansvaret för en hormonmottagning.

I Næstved består avdelningen av ett trombos- och koagulationscentrum, en hjärtmottagning samt det vårdmässiga ansvaret för en hormonmottagning. Utöver detta rymmer lokalerna även ett diagnostiskt centrum.

Vi är för närvarande 12 specialistläkare inom kardiologi samt specialistläkare inom avdelningens övriga specialistfunktioner.

Vi ansvarar för undervisningen av medicinstudenter från Köpenhamns universitet.

Därför ska du välja Midt- och Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- och Vestsjællands Hospital fokuserar vi på yrkeskompetens, samarbete mellan professioner, kvalitet, utbildning och forskning.

Specialister spelar en central roll både för den kliniska verksamheten och för den ämnesspecifika utvecklingen, och du blir en del av en miljö med hög grad av specialisering, tydliga ambitioner och goda möjligheter att påverka utvecklingen inom ditt specialistområde.

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där fokus ligger på vårdkvalitet, kontinuitet i patientförloppet och förutsättningar som främjar såväl kliniskt arbete som utbildning och forskning.

Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats kommer att vara i Slagelse som har goda transportförbindelser med bland annat Odense, Köpenhamn och övriga Själland.

Är du redo för nästa steg?

Vill du vara med och utveckla kardiologin på Midt- og Vestsjælland? Då ser vi gärna att du hör av dig.

Mer information

Om du vill ha mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta tillförordnad chefsläkare Roman Sykulski på tel. +45 56 51 41 34 eller chefsjuksköterska Camilla Vest på tel. +45 93 56 84 89.

Villkor, lön och anställning

Du kommer att ingå i ett jourteam med bakjoursansvar från ditt eget hem i egenskap av överläkare och ha jour utanför arbetsplatsen i egenskap av specialistläkare.

Vi har omfattande erfarenhet av att hitta flexibla lösningar som möjliggör ett hållbart arbetsliv, så kontakta oss gärna för ett förutsättningslöst samtal om vilka möjligheter som finns.

Den professionella bedömningen av sökanden kommer att baseras på sökandens uppgifter om sina egna kompetenser i förhållande till de sju läkartjänsterna. Om du söker en tjänst som överläkare kommer en professionell bedömning att genomföras som kommer att vara avgörande för din kvalifikation som överläkare.

Anställningen sker enligt avtalet mellan Danske Regioner och YL/Overlægeforeningen, beroende på vilken tjänst som söks, och är villkorad med att det finns en tillfredsställande børneattest (utdrag ur belastningsregistret som visar om en person dömts för sexualbrott mot barn under 15 år).

Vi önskar tillsätta tjänsten senast eller enligt överenskommelse.

Hjälp med flytt och undervisning i danska

Om du vill flytta till Danmark i samband med anställningen erbjuder vi kostnadsfri, professionell hjälp med flytt och bosättning nära sjukhuset eller eventuellt i Köpenhamn. Du får hjälp med allt från att hitta boende till registrering och eventuella medföljande familjemedlemmar.

En viktig del av arbetet som specialistläkare är kommunikationen mellan läkare och patient. För patientsäkerhetens skull kräver därför Region Sjælland att våra specialistläkare ska ha kunskaper i danska språket på en tillfredsställande nivå. Vi tillhandahåller därför en språklärare för privatundervisning så att du så snabbt som möjligt kan kommunicera med dina patienter på en nivå där ni förstår varandra.

Det innebär att vi förväntar oss att du är inställd på att lägga tid på att lära dig danska, både i tal och skrift.

Se mer om vad vi erbjuder i form av hjälp här

Rekryteringsprocessen

När vi har mottagit din ansökan kommer vi att bedöma om dina kvalifikationer matchar det vi söker, och du kommer initialt att bjudas in till en intervju via Teams. Om båda parter är intresserade av att fortsätta dialogen kommer du att bjudas in till ett rekryteringssamtal på sjukhuset, där du får träffa avdelningens ledning och personal samt vår HR- och språkkonsult.

Ansökningstid

Vi kommer att granska ansökningarna till tjänsten löpande, så vänta inte för länge med att ansöka.

Verksamhetsområde

Den 1 januari 2027 slås Region Själland och Region Hovedstaden samman och bildar Region Østdanmark till följd av sjukvårdsreformen. Ditt verksamhetsområde kommer att vara Region Østdanmark, inklusive alla tillhörande organisatoriska enheter.

Läs mer om vad verksamhetsområdet innebär på Region Østdanmarks webbplats.

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbetar vi varje dag för att främja ett hälsosamt liv genom förebyggande åtgärder och behandling inom ramen för en samordnad hälso- och sjukvårdsinsats. Som sjukhus förenar vi psykiatri och somatik. Vårt mål är att patienter och medborgare ska få bra och trygg vård av hög kvalitet.

Som medarbetare blir du en del av ett innovativt, kompetent och organisatoriskt stabilt sjukhus där vi gör skillnad för de människor som behöver oss. Lärande och utveckling är en del av vardagen och sker i professionella sammanhang med ett gemensamt ansvar. Det sker även mellan olika avdelningar.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital betjänar ett upptagningsområde med cirka 230 000 invånare. Vi har 766 vårdplatser och cirka 5 000 anställda fördelade på 20 avdelningar, däribland 16 somatiska och psykiatriska avdelningar.

Vi erbjuder en gedigen forskningsmiljö med 13 professorer och en stark yrkesmässig utbildningsmiljö, där vi varje år välkomnar cirka 2 700 studenter, elever och läkare som deltar i vidareutbildning.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

Oplysninger om lønniveau kommer fra kapa.ai

Oplysninger om dette lønniveau kommer fra kapa.ai. Din faktiske løn vil være baseret på dine kompetencer og din erfaring – tal med din rekrutteringskonsulent for at høre mere.

Job Description

At Netcompany, we are looking for a student who wants to take part in our innovative projects. Here, you will have the chance to influence our solutions while working alongside some of the industry’s most skilled colleagues, who will inspire you and support your learning.

Responsibilities and technologies

As a student assistant with us, you will be given responsibility from day one and become an important part of one of our teams. You will experience how your work directly contributes and creates value in the solutions we deliver to our clients. A student position with us gives you the opportunity to take on challenging tasks on equal footing with our full-time consultants.

We follow a well-established methodology from identifying client needs to implementing and rolling out solutions. You will therefore gain hands-on experience with developing IT systems from start to finish. You will primarily work on IT solutions and service-oriented architectures based on .NET and Java technologies, typically within maintenance, development and testing. The role provides the opportunity to put many of the skills gained during your studies into practice.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Developing functional and technical designs for system components.

• Programming tasks across all layers of the system.

• Configuration and development of extensions for standard platforms.

• Automation of business processes.

About you

We are looking for a student who can work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to project deadlines and other key milestones. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field.

• Have some experience with object-oriented programming and familiarity with languages such as C# .NET and/or Java.

• Are highly motivated and eager to develop your skills.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. Chainalysis is the cryptocurrency ghostbusters, pioneering in the blockchain analysis space. Identifying high-risk activities on the blockchain, playing a central role in ensuring cryptocurrencies are used for a legitimate purpose. Ultimately, Chainalysis is building trust in blockchains.

The Chainalysis engineering team solves large scale, technically complex data problems by ingesting, transforming and supporting nearly 1TB of data per day across multiple blockchains serving public and private sectors internationally. Our industry is evolving at a rapid pace and our job is to build a flexible platform that will allow us to adapt accordingly.

Software Engineers are at the epicenter of that mission by building and scaling the data pipelines, infrastructure and applications our customers rely on every day to stop crime, reduce financial risk and prevent financial loss.

• Develop and deploy high quality code using modern frameworks and technologies within AWS and GCP such as lambdas, Kafka, S3, Java, Typescript, Databricks, etc.

• Debug production issues and participated in a blameless post-mortem process to make our systems stronger

To Achieve Success In This Role You Have

• A strong sense of urgency and solid working engine

• Computer Science degree (or similar technical degree) in progress with an expected graduation date during 2027

• Demonstrated applications development or data engineering experience from previous internships, work experience, coding/startup competitions, open source contributions or publications

• Participated in code and architecture reviews at internships or open source projects

• Used or been exposed to React/Angular, Kafka, Spring boot and Postgres

• Strong interest in learning about cryptocurrencies from some of the most knowledgeable people in the field

About Chainalysis

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, and investigate criminal cases. As adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. Do you want to take a central role in shaping how a high‑tech defense company secures reliability, compliance and world‑class product integrity on a global scale? You will be responsible for safeguarding Sky-Watch’s Quality Management System, driving compliance with AS9100, ISO 9001 and AQAP, and enabling stable, scalable execution in an increasingly demanding international defense environment. Through strong cross functional leadership and data driven governance, you will strengthen decision making, reduce operational risk, accelerate execution stability and help deliver a dependable customer experience built on safety, performance and traceability.

Joining Sky‑Watch means stepping into a fast‑growing scale‑up where reliability is a strategic differentiator — and where your expertise will directly influence both day‑to‑day operations and the company’s ongoing global growth journey.

You will report directly to the CEO, including direct leadership responsibility for the QA Manager and dotted line leadership of the QC Manager.

In this role, you act as a trusted advisor to the Executive Management Team, providing clear, fact based recommendations on quality, risk and compliance, and contributing actively to strategic decision‑making at enterprise level.

Your key responsibilities include:

• QHSE Strategy & Policy

• Sky‑Watch QMS (AS9100 / ISO 9001 / AQAP)

• Quality Governance & Risk Management

• Digital QHSE & Data Governance

• Continuous Improvement & NCR / CAPA

• Supplier Quality Requirements & APQP / PPAP

• Manufacturing Quality & QC oversight

• Audits & Compliance

• Health, Safety & Environment (in collaboration with the Health & Safety

You possess deep knowledge of AS9100, AQAP and ISO 9001 requirements and are comfortable working with lifecycle product safety in a regulated environment.
